content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

idx = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([["West", "East"], ["Tea", "Juice"]], names=["region", "product"])
df = pd.DataFrame({"units": [2, 4, 3, 5]}, index=idx)
print(df.loc[("West", "Tea"), "units"])
